```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(blavaan)
library(lavaan)
```

```{r}
polentometro_dim <- readRDS("data/derived/polentometro_dim.rds")

semdiff <- polentometro_dim |> 
  dplyr::select(CASE, educated:urban) |> 
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(across(educated:urban, as.ordered))

semdiff_lik <- semdiff |> 
  select(-CASE)
```

```{r}
EPA_model <- '
  Evaluation =~ refined + friendly + kind
  Potency    =~ educated + rich + urban
  Activity   =~ modern + funny
'

fit_EPA <- sem(EPA_model, data = as.data.frame(semdiff), ordered = colnames(semdiff_lik))

summary(fit_EPA)
```

```{r}
factor_scores <- lavPredict(fit_EPA)
```

```{r}
factor_scores |> 
  ggplot(aes(Attitude)) +
  geom_density()
```
